fingerprint: FNV-1a 32-bit of each original index value encoded as a canonical uint32 little-endian value; independent of GPU index type. Must compare the complete draw range.
jointMethod: Each joint is a linear combination of exact CPU-skinned vertex samples. Rigid tetrahedra use dominant weights; other principal joints solve the actual weighted rest-position skinning equations. Coefficients reproduce the inverse-bindpose bone origin. Validate extra samples before drawing. Missing joints are intentionally absent.
